name: minidroid
description: MiniDroid engineering skill for analyzing, testing, debugging and extending the bundled portable Android compatibility runtime for Linux x86_64.

interface.longDescription: Engineering skill for the bundled MiniDroid Linux x86_64 runtime, its Android Manager, package/process/storage bridges, ADB, add-ons and compatibility packs.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the bundled MiniDroid runtime and report its current state.
Debug this MiniDroid APK launch failure without regressing the core.
Improve MiniDroid and run the relevant regression tests.

publication.release_notes: Adds public policy URLs and packaged MiniDroid branding assets for directory submission.
